title: 第17章 不是你宰我还是我宰你啊第18章 哪个没娘的又陷害老子
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 林筱先去了鉴宝阁，一番询问后没有她又去了任务堂，一个整理任务的弟子看到林筱赶忙行礼：“见过大师姐。”
林筱直接问道：“有天仙子的任务吗？”
“有有。”
男弟子手一挥，密密麻麻的任务从他眼前划过，他抬手一抓将一块玉牌递给林筱，“大师姐，天仙子任务的细节就在这块玉牌里了，玄极任务较有难度，师姐万事小心。”
林筱接过玉牌，信息便自动浮现在了她眼前。
林筱四处看看，发现没人朝她看过来，看来这些字是只有她能看见。
【玄品中阶任务：寻找六品药材天仙子，任务完成奖励弟子七品回元丹一枚，任务参考地点：灵竹林（点击可查看）】
这还自带地图？太方便了吧。
林筱点了一下那个‘点击可查看’，脑海中就跟有人给她注入导航了一样，起点在天衍宗，终点是灵竹林。
林筱没有过多准备就离开了天衍宗，她也不怕什么，毕竟背包里还有系统给的传送符呢，大不了遇到危险跑路呗。
下山后的林筱进入了一座城池，街市热闹，两边都是叫卖东西的，其中一个嗓门最大的吸引了林筱注意，她偏头看去，正好和一个少年对上眼。
少年一双星辰般的眸子，笑起来时弯成两个月牙，唇红齿白像是橱柜里的瓷娃娃。
阳光撒在他身上，却没有他的笑容明媚，细风吹过他额间碎发，一股子独属于少年的热烈之气扑面而来。
他看着林筱，明明素不相识，但给林筱一种，少年认识她且眼中只有她一人的错觉。
这个错觉，前一个待在少年铺子前的姑娘也有。
稀里糊涂付了钱，也不知道少年在她手里塞了什么东西，那姑娘从始至终眼里只有少年的脸，眼珠子就差掉出来黏在少年身上了。
“慢走不送哈。”
把钱快速塞进兜里，少年便不再理会仍站在他铺子前不肯走的姑娘，从兜里掏出一张画着奇怪字符的纸跃过人群精准的朝林筱跑来。
“姐姐，要买符吗？”
少年对林筱露出一个足以迷昏所有少女的明艳笑容。
少年周身似乎莹莹透着一层润光，让他看上去更加的惹人注目，不少人在看到少年那一刻就会对他心生好感，无意识放松芥蒂。
但同样在底圈摸爬滚打出来的林筱却一眼看透了少年的笑虽然热情，但并不达眼底，这副无害模样也是他装出来骗人的把戏。
少年怎么想也想不到，自己骗到了一个曾经和他几乎算同行的人。
少年长得是好看，但林筱可不是轻易上当之人，收回落在少年脸上的目光，她淡淡道：“不买。”
说着，林筱绕过少年就要离开。
她这副冷漠样子让少年一愣，他刚刚见林筱一直看着他还以为又是一个大冤种被钓上钩了，这怎么和他想的不一样呢？
不知哪来的直觉，少年觉得林筱对符不是很了解，如果能骗到她，他今天就可以早早收摊回去休息了。
少年快步跑到林筱面前，“小姐姐等一等，你是修道之人吧。”
content_en:
Lin Xiao first went to the Treasure Appraisal Pavilion. After some questioning, she went to the mission hall without her. A disciple who was sorting out missions saw Lin Xiao and hurriedly saluted: "I have met senior sister."
Lin Xiao asked directly: "Is there a mission for the fairy?"
"Yes, yes."
The male disciple waved his hand, and densely packed tasks flashed past his eyes. He raised his hand and handed a jade tablet to Lin Xiao, "Senior Sister, the details of the Tianxianzi mission are in this jade tablet. The Xuanji mission is more difficult, senior sister, be careful."
Lin Xiao took the jade token, and the information automatically appeared in front of her eyes.
Lin Xiao looked around and found that no one was looking towards her. It seemed that only she could see these words.
[Xuanpin Intermediate Mission: Find the sixth-grade medicinal material Tian Xianzi. Completion of the mission will reward the disciple with a seventh-grade Yuanhui Dan. Mission reference location: Lingzhu Forest (click to view)]
Does this come with a map? It's so convenient.
Lin Xiao clicked on the 'click to view', and in her mind it was as if someone had injected navigation into her. The starting point was Tianyan Sect and the end point was Lingzhu Forest.
Lin Xiao left Tianyan Sect without much preparation. She was not afraid of anything. After all, she still had the teleportation talisman given by the system in her backpack. At worst, she would run away if she encountered danger.
…
After going down the mountain, Lin Xiao entered a city. The market was bustling with people selling things on both sides. One of them with the loudest voice attracted Lin Xiao's attention. She turned her head and looked up, and she happened to meet the eyes of a young man.
The young man has a pair of star-like eyes, which curve into two crescents when he smiles. His red lips and white teeth look like a porcelain doll in the cupboard.
The sun shone on him, but it was not as bright as his smile. The gentle wind blew through the broken hair on his forehead, and a warm aura unique to a young man hit his face.
He looked at Lin Xiao. He clearly didn't know her, but he gave Lin Xiao the illusion that the young man knew her and that she was the only one in his eyes.
This illusion was also shared by the girl who stayed in front of the boy's shop.
She paid the money in a daze and didn't know what the boy put in her hand. From the beginning to the end, the girl only saw the boy's face, and her eyeballs almost fell out and stuck to the boy's body.
"Go slowly and don't see me off."
Quickly stuffing the money into his pocket, the young man ignored the girl who was still standing in front of his shop and refused to leave. He took out a piece of paper with strange characters on it and jumped over the crowd and ran towards Lin Xiao accurately.
"Sister, do you want to buy a charm?"
The young man showed Lin Xiao a bright smile that could stun all the girls.
There seemed to be a layer of radiance all over the young man's body, making him look even more eye-catching. Many people would fall in love with the young man the moment they saw him and unconsciously relax their grudges.
But Lin Xiao, who was also struggling in the bottom circle, could see at a glance that although the boy's smile was enthusiastic, it didn't reach his eyes. This harmless look was also a trick he put on to deceive others.
The young man never imagined that he would deceive someone who was almost a companion to him.
The young man was good-looking, but Lin Xiao was not one to be fooled easily. She withdrew her gaze from the young man's face and said calmly: "I won't buy it."
With that said, Lin Xiao walked around the young man and was about to leave.
Her indifferent look made the young man stunned. He had just seen Lin Xiao looking at him and thought that another big enemy had been hooked. How could this be different from what he thought?
Out of some intuition, the young man felt that Lin Xiao didn't know Fu very well. If he could deceive her, he could close the stall early and go back to rest today.
The young man quickly ran to Lin Xiao and said, "Little sister, wait a minute, you are a Taoist."
title_en: Chapter 17: Either you kill me or I kill you Chapter 18: Which motherless person framed me again
